## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper strategy captures short-term SPY 0DTE moves using premium-based exits, time stops, and volume filters. Its edge comes from avoiding large losses on losing days while capturing modest gains on winners, though current J-day capture is weak.

## Mechanism

Entry: Triggered by shotgun_scalper-specific logic (not detailed in keeper) using `strike_offset`=2 (likely OTM-2) and `vol_ratio_threshold`=1.0 (volume at least average).  
Exit:  
- TP1 at +150% premium (`tp_premium_pct`=1.5)  
- Stop at -35% premium (`stop_premium_pct`=-0.35)  
- Time stop at 15 minutes  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at 50% (`chandelier_arm_pct`=0.5) of favorable move
